Acne.description: A common skin condition where hair follicles become blocked with oil and dead skin, producing whiteheads, blackheads, pimples, or deeper lumps, most often on the face.
Acne.risk_action: Consult a dermatologist for confirmation and an appropriate treatment plan, especially if lesions are painful, widespread, or scarring.

Melasma.description: A common pigmentation condition causing brown or grey-brown patches, usually on the cheeks, forehead, or upper lip, often linked to sun exposure or hormonal changes.
Melasma.risk_action: Consult a dermatologist for confirmation and guidance on sun protection and treatment options.

Acne Conglobata.description: A severe, uncommon form of acne with deep, interconnected nodules and abscesses that can lead to significant scarring if untreated.
Acne Conglobata.risk_action: Consult a dermatologist for confirmation; this form of acne often needs prompt, more intensive medical treatment.
